**Thank you for the suggestion.** Please fill in the sections below.

## Problem / use case

What are you trying to achieve? Which RF/microwave workflow is blocked today?

## Proposed solution

What should rfauto do? If you have an idea about the API shape (service
function, CLI command, UI page), sketch it — but implementation details are
not required.

## Alternatives considered

Other tools, workarounds, or existing rfauto features you tried.

## Physics / engineering context (optional)

For template, solver, or measurement requests: the device family, frequency
range, and any reference (textbook closed-form, official example, paper) that
defines "correct". rfauto validates numerical features against independent
references, so a verifiable acceptance criterion helps a lot.

## Willingness to contribute

- [ ] I am willing to help implement this (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I can provide test data or references
